mofaplus_local.corpus: No upstream checkpoint; every sample in a local fit receives fitted latent factors

interpretation: MOFA+ natively masks missing entries with NaN and can reconstruct an absent view for samples whose latent Z values were fitted. It has no amortized or official frozen transform from a new sample's RNA measurements to Z. Ordinary imputation therefore cannot be used for held or sealed donors without inserting and fitting those donors. MEFISTO predict_factor extrapolates factors from covariate coordinates, not from a new RNA assay. MOFA+ remains deferred until a separate nonpromotable development TaskSpec exists and is excluded from GSE289173.
remaining_blockers: Do not schedule MOFA+ until a separate nonpromotable development-only integration TaskSpec defines the sample unit, likelihoods, metrics, and transductive interpretation.
Never insert GSE289173 rows with ATAC set to NaN, optimize query Z, refit W/Z, or use MEFISTO covariate prediction as an RNA assay transform.

Freeze donor or donor-by-cell-state sample IDs, GENCODE v49 genes, GRCh38.p14 peaks, likelihood per view, missingness masks, centering/scaling, factor count, sparsity/ARD options, convergence, donor grouping, seeds, and artifact hashes.

Prove NaN masks exclude absent observations and preserve project missingness reasons externally; missing evidence is never encoded as biological zero.
